subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: Should this PR become the canonical Mattermost thread-history recovery fix, and is the one bounded inbound thread fetch per history key/stored session id acceptable?
rationale: The patch is viable and well-proven, but multiple open PRs target the same issue and the new awaited server fetch is a deliberate channel availability and session-state tradeoff.

options.title: Refresh And Land This Candidate
options.body: Use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix after reviewing the current merge result and accepting the bounded fetch behavior.

options.title: Pick The Sibling Candidate
options.body: Fresh-review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243 instead if maintainers prefer that implementation shape, then close this PR as superseded after the sibling merges.

options.title: Pause For Owner Direction
options.body: Hold both candidate PRs until a Mattermost/session owner chooses the permanent recovery semantics and fetch budget.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Land This Candidate
recommendation.body: Use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix after reviewing the current merge result and accepting the bounded fetch behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses Mattermost plugin behavior and shared inbound history/session semantics that steipete recently refactored.
